result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with multiple travel lanes and high-visibility continental crosswalks. While pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks, curb ramps, and a bike lane are present, the long crossing distance and presence of a slip lane increase risk for non-motorized users.

hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period.

hazards.name: Channelized Right-Turn Lane
hazards.description: The slip lane allows for higher vehicle speeds during turns, increasing the risk of conflict with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island Enhancement
interventions.description: Improve the existing refuge island to provide better protection and more space for pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks, but the wide roadway creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians. interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.
